explication: Databend is a Rust enterprise data warehouse. Its principal workflow is a client submitting SQL through the HTTP query API, followed by query planning and pipeline execution; results are returned through the query interface. The README also describes analytics, vector and full-text search, schema evolution, transactions, branching, and sandboxed Python UDFs. The graph preserves these product areas, but several are represented by their existing source directories because their implementations were not sampled. Links without direct evidence are omitted or marked unverified.
